div.div: Configure menu, model, field, button, tab and chatter restrictions from one clean policy screen.
Apply this policy to individual users, user groups, or both.

field.name: group_ids
field.placeholder: Select user groups for this policy

field.name: user_ids
field.placeholder: Select individual users for this policy

page.name: field_controls
page.div: Configure all field controls in one place. Leave Condition empty/[] for always-applied Hide, Read Only, or Required rules; set a condition when the same controls should apply only in a specific record state.

div.div: Select a model and field, then open any tab below and configure the rule directly.

page.name: attribute_rule
page.div: Control field visibility, editability, requirement, and the record condition where those attributes apply.

page.name: domain_rule
page.div: Restrict the selectable records of a Many2one or Many2many field with a domain.

page.name: selection_value_filter
page.div: For a Selection field choose allowed options; for a Many2one field choose allowed related records (such as UOMs). Each rule applies only to its own model and field for users covered by this policy.
This field is not a Selection or Many2one field. To filter UOM choices, select the Many2one Quantity UOM field on the source model, not the Unit Name (Char) field on the UOM model.

field.name: enable_selection_filter
field.invisible: not field_id or field_type not in ('selection', 'many2one')

page.name: import_export_rule
page.div: Prevent this field from appearing in import or export field selection for users covered by the policy.

page.name: attribute_rule
page.div:

Hide Field + Match all records is global: it hides the field from Form, List, Kanban, Search/Filter, Group By, Pivot/Graph and Export. Apply On remains relevant for Read Only, Required, and conditional Hide rules.
